recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Any future proposal to remove, rename, or remap DocumentReference.related should be handled as a new OO tracker because FHIR-32585 has been superseded by later applied DocumentReference decisions.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification OO issue asking to remove the open-ended DocumentReference.related element, add DocumentReference to workflow-supportingInfo usage, and move the old XDS mapping away from related.
initial_application: Commit 1211a3b963 removed DocumentReference.related from the active StructureDefinition and moved the example's related Patient reference into workflow-supportingInfo. The PR merge recorded in Jira, 333a55c82177, also removed the related search parameter and added DocumentReference to the then-core workflow-supportingInfo extension context list.
additional_context: FHIR-41186 later restored an Any-capable DocumentReference association by bringing back related after implementers found the R5 removal too limiting. FHIR-53824 and FHIR-53550 then retained related but made it a coded backbone with a Reference(Any) target and clarified that relatesTo is for document-reference lifecycle links. The workflow-supportingInfo extension now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack and still includes DocumentReference as an allowed context.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current build-scope core source has active DocumentReference, related as the later approved coded non-lifecycle backbone, related.target search wiring, and lifecycle-focused relatesTo. Removing related again would undo later applied OO decisions.
